context: Daichi shows Sho-young how to make Mochi together for new year.
purpose: Father teaching son traditional food prep.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Dad, this mochi is really hard!
lines.style: Small, frustrated voice cracking slightly on the complaint. Warm underneath — he's asking for help, not complaining at you. Genuine child-sized exertion in the tone.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Knead it — put some muscle into it.
lines.style: Encouraging Kansai cadence, light and easy. Not drilling him, just showing the way. Warm hand-on-shoulder energy in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Do we eat this on New Year's?
lines.style: Sudden curiosity, brighter energy. Asking because he actually wants to know, not just making conversation. Engaged, almost bouncing slightly in the question.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Fond, settled voice. Pride in the ordinary thing. Kansai warmth without loudness. The voice of a man happy to pass something down.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yes! I'm really looking forward to it!
lines.style: Pure joy breaking through, unselfconscious child delight. Quick, bright attack on the opening. No performance — just real excitement bubbling up.
